source_title: Ambiguous Figures - What Happens in the Brain When Perception Changes But Not the Stimulus
abstracted_dimensions: ambiguous figures support changing percepts while the visual stimulus remains unchanged
one shared contour two complete readings and unchanged physical marks are stronger evidence than two overlaid pictures

research_limitations: perceptual reversal varies by observer and viewing time
a generated image can provide ambiguous structure but cannot guarantee that every viewer experiences both readings
